# RedForge

这是一个面向渗透测试与攻防演练的渗透测试与攻防演练平台。长期目标是提供资产发现与指纹识别、端口与服务测绘、漏洞模板匹配、凭证探测、载荷生成、攻击链编排、授权边界强制和结果评分，把攻防演练沉淀为可复用平台。

仓库采用 Python，当前冻结基线只提供进程健康检查。后续能力必须通过独立题目逐步实现；每个题目都应定义可观察的公共行为、兼容边界和失败语义，不得依赖未公开内部 API。

## 启动

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m redforge.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

服务默认监听 `127.0.0.1:8080`，可通过 `REDFORGE_ADDR` 修改。`GET /healthz` 返回 JSON 健康状态。

## 接口

- `POST /v1/scope/evaluate`：以 `allow`/`deny` 规则评估 `targets` 的授权范围，纯本地判定。
- `POST /v1/vulnerabilities/match`：离线漏洞模板匹配。请求体含 `allow`、`deny`、`templates`、`observations`；
  先对全部观察目标执行范围评估（任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`），再把每个观察与每个模板按
  `all`/`any` 逻辑匹配，响应仅含 `findings`（按观察顺序、再按模板顺序），每项给出 `observation_id`、
  规范化 `target`、`template_id`、`name`、`severity` 和命中匹配器下标 `evidence`。
- `POST /v1/assets/fingerprint`：在本地把端口观测识别为服务资产，不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、
  `deny`、`fingerprints`、`observations`，后两项可为空数组；`observations` 的每项仅含 `id`（唯一非空字符串）、
  `target`（沿用既有目标语法，不得为通配符）、`port`（1–65535 的非布尔整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或
  `udp`）、`banner`（字符串）。`fingerprints` 的每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、非空 `name` 和 `service`、非布尔整数
  `priority`、值为 `all` 或 `any` 的 `logic`、非空 `matchers`。匹配器只能三选一：仅含 `ports`（无重复的
  1–65535 非布尔整数非空数组）、仅含 `transport`（`tcp` 或 `udp`），或仅含 `operator` 与非空 `value`（针对
  `banner`，operator 仅限 `equals`、`contains`、`regex`）；文本比较区分大小写，`regex` 使用搜索语义，非法
  表达式令请求无效。先完成全部结构校验（结构错误、重复 `id`、或规范化 `target`+`transport`+`port` 相同的重复
  端点均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个观测的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403
  `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。通过后按 `all`（全部匹配器命中）/`any`（至少一个命中）判定指纹命中，
  多指纹命中时选择 `priority` 最大者，并列选择输入靠前者；evidence 为命中匹配器下标，按下标升序返回。成功响应
  仅含 `assets`：按目标首次出现顺序分组，每项含规范化 `target` 和 `services`；services 保持观测顺序，每项含
  `observation_id`、`port`、`transport`、`service`、`fingerprint_id`、`name`、`evidence`。未命中任何指纹时
  `service` 为 `"unknown"`，`fingerprint_id` 与 `name` 为 `null`，`evidence` 为空数组；空 `observations`
  返回空 `assets`；相同输入内容与顺序产生稳定结果。
- `POST /v1/findings/consolidate`：汇总多次扫描的匹配结果，纯本地处理。请求体含 `allow`、`deny` 和非空
  `runs`；每个 run 有唯一非空 `id`、0–100 的整数 `reliability` 和 `findings`（字段与
  `/v1/vulnerabilities/match` 的单项一致，拒绝未知字段）。先对全部 finding 的 `target` 执行范围评估，
  任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`；随后以规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id` 为键去重，
  按首次出现顺序返回 `consolidated`：保留首次出现的 `name`（同键不同 name 为 400），`severity` 取最高者，
  `observation_ids` 与 `sources`（run id）各自按首次出现顺序去重，`evidence` 合并为升序去重的非负整数；
  `confidence` 对包含该键的每个不同 run 按 runs 顺序计算
  `c = c + floor((100 - c) * reliability / 100)`（c 从 0 开始），同一 run 内的重复 finding 只计一次
  置信度，但仍参与观察编号与证据合并。没有 finding 时返回空数组；结构错误一律 400 `invalid_request`。
- `POST /v1/findings/retest`：把一次复测与既有汇总结果比较，纯本地处理。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、
  `baseline`、`retest_runs`；`baseline` 是既有 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 同形数组（可为空），
  `retest_runs` 是非空 runs 同形数组。先完成全部结构校验，再对两侧每个 finding 的规范化 `target`
  执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回比较结果；通过后按既有汇总语义生成本次结果。
  比较键为规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id`；baseline 键重复、同键 name 冲突、非法
  severity/confidence/evidence、重复 run id、字段缺失或多余均返回 400 `invalid_request`（confidence
  为 0–100 的非布尔整数，evidence 为非负整数数组）。成功响应仅含 `comparisons` 和 `summary`：
  comparisons 先按 baseline 顺序给出同键 `persistent` 或缺失 `resolved`，再按本次汇总首次出现顺序追加
  baseline 没有的 `new`；每项只含 `target`、`template_id`、`name`（优先取 baseline）、`status`、
  `before`、`after`（两侧为完整汇总项，缺失为 `null`；字段变化不改变状态）。summary 只含
  `total_before`、`total_after`、`persistent`、`resolved`、`new` 五个一致整数。空 baseline 可产生
  `new`；复测无发现时 baseline 项全部为 `resolved`；同一输入数组顺序稳定。
- `POST /v1/attack-chains/plan`：按目标规划攻击链阶段，纯本地处理，不执行阶段、不持久化。请求体仅含
  `allow`、`deny`、`findings`、`stages`；`findings` 与 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 数组同形且可为空，
  `stages` 为非空数组，每个阶段含非空 `id`（唯一）、`name`、`logic`（`all`/`any`）、非空 `requires`
  （每项仅含 `template_id`、`min_severity`、`min_confidence`，后者为 0–100 的非布尔整数）和
  `depends_on`（阶段 id 数组，不得重复、自指、引用未知 id 或成环）。先完成全部结构校验（finding 的规范化
  `target` 与 `template_id` 组合重复、阶段 id 重复或依赖无效均为 400 `invalid_request`），再对全部
  finding 的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部计划。
  通过后按规范化 `target` 分组（目标保持首次出现顺序），条件仅匹配同一目标下 `template_id` 大小写一致、
  `severity` 与 `confidence` 均达门槛的发现项；阶段按拓扑顺序评估（同层保持输入顺序），自身条件成立且
  所有依赖均为 `ready` 时状态为 `ready`（`reason` 为 `null`），条件不成立时为 `skipped` 且原因为
  `missing_requirements`，条件成立但依赖未就绪时原因为 `dependency_blocked`。成功响应仅含 `plans`，
  每项含 `target` 和覆盖所有阶段的 `stages`（阶段结果含 `id`、`name`、`status`、`reason`）；空
  `findings` 返回空 `plans`，相同输入的数组顺序稳定。
- `POST /v1/reports/export`：把既有结果导出为单一稳定的证据报告，纯本地处理。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、
  `title`、`findings`、`comparisons`、`plans`；`title` 为非空字符串，后三项分别沿用 consolidate、retest 和
  attack-chains/plan 的结果项，均为可空数组。先完成结构及交叉一致性校验：以规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的
  `template_id` 为键，各数组内不得重复；comparison 的 `status` 仅可为 `persistent`、`resolved`、`new`，
  `before`/`after` 的空值位置须符合状态，非空项须与外层键一致；`comparisons` 非空时，非空 `after` 须与
  `findings` 的同键项完整一致，且 `findings` 不得有未被比较的当前项；plan 的 `target` 唯一且须存在于当前
  findings，阶段 `id` 在单个计划内唯一，`status` 与 `reason` 只能采用 `ready`/`null`、
  `skipped`/`missing_requirements`、`skipped`/`dependency_blocked` 三种既有组合；同键出现不同 `name`
  也属不一致。上述错误一律返回 400 `invalid_request`。结构校验通过后，对全部 `target` 执行范围评估，
  任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部报告。成功响应仅含 `report`：`schema_version`
  为字符串 `"1.0"`，`title` 原样保留；`summary` 只含 `targets`、`current_findings`、`persistent`、
  `resolved`、`new`、`ready_stages`、`skipped_stages` 七个计数；`targets` 为分组报告，目标按 findings
  首次出现排序、再追加仅见于 comparisons 的目标，每个目标项只含规范化 `target`、`findings`、`comparisons`、
  `stages`。计数从实际内容计算，空输入返回全零 summary 和空 targets，相同输入产生相同结果。
- `POST /v1/credentials/analyze`：离线分析凭证观测中的弱口令迹象，不联网、不持久化任何口令，响应与错误
  均不回显 `secret` 或 `weak_secrets` 内容。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`attempts`；`policy`
  仅含 `min_length`（1–128 的非布尔整数）与 `weak_secrets`（元素唯一的非空字符串数组）；`attempts` 可为空
  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、非空 `target`（沿用既有目标语法，不得为通配符）、`port`（1–65535 的非布尔
  整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或 `udp`）、非空 `service`、非空 `username`、字符串 `secret`、布尔
  `authenticated`。先完成全部结构校验（结构错误、重复 `id`、`weak_secrets` 重复、目标或范围规则非法均
  返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个尝试的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403
  `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。仅 `authenticated` 为 `true` 且命中条件的观测产生 finding：`secret`
  为空命中 `empty_secret`，与 `username` 大小写敏感地相同命中 `username_equals_secret`，等于任一
  `weak_secrets` 命中 `dictionary_secret`，Unicode 码点数小于 `min_length` 命中 `short_secret`；同一观测
  可命中多项，`weakness_codes` 按上述次序排列，四项 severity 依次为 critical、critical、high、medium，
  finding 的 `severity` 取其中最高级。成功响应仅含 `findings`，顺序与 `attempts` 一致；每项只含
  `attempt_id`、规范化 `target`、`port`、`transport`、`service`、`username`、`severity`、
  `weakness_codes`。未认证、未命中或空 `attempts` 均得到空 `findings`。
- `POST /v1/payloads/generate`：离线生成确定性载荷变体，不联网、不执行载荷、不持久化任何内容。请求体仅含
  `allow`、`deny`、`target`、`items`；`target` 沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符，`items` 可为空数组。
  每个 item 仅含该请求内唯一非空 `id`、非空 `template`、`variables` 和 `variants`；`variables` 是变量名
  （匹配 `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`）到字符串的对象。`template` 用 `${name}` 引用变量，引用缺值、存在多余
  变量或出现畸形占位符均令请求无效；替换只进行一次，变量值中的 `${...}` 不再展开。每个 variant 仅含该 item
  内唯一非空 `id` 和 `steps`；`steps` 可为空数组，元素只能是 `url_percent`、`base64`、`hex`，可重复并
  按顺序应用，未知步骤令请求无效。各变体均从该 item 替换后的文本独立开始：`url_percent` 先编码为 UTF-8，
  ASCII 字母、数字及 `-._~` 原样保留，其余字节写成大写 `%HH`；`base64` 输出 UTF-8 字节的标准 Base64 并
  保留 `=` 填充；`hex` 输出 UTF-8 字节的小写十六进制且不带前缀；前一步输出供下一步处理。先完成全部结构
  校验（字段缺失或未知、类型错误、重复标识、非法变量、占位符错误、未知步骤均返回 400
  `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查单个规范化 target，未授权时整体返回 403
  `scope_violation`；`items` 为空仍检查范围。成功响应仅含 `generated`，按 items、variants 输入顺序排列；
  每项仅含 `item_id`、`variant_id`、规范化 `target`、原顺序 `steps` 和 `value`。空 `steps` 返回替换后的
  原文；空 `items` 或 item 无 variant 时返回空数组；value 相同但标识不同的结果不合并，相同输入始终产生
  相同内容与顺序。
- `POST /v1/sessions/escalation-paths`：离线计算起始会话到权限目标的最佳提权路径，不联网、不持久化、不落盘。
  请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`sessions`、`transitions`、`starts`、`goals`，各数组均可空，未知字段令请求无效。
  三类条目在各自数组内拥有唯一非空字符串 `id`：session 每项仅含 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的
  `target`、`privilege`（仅 `user`、`admin`、`system`，权限由低到高）；transition 每项仅含 `id`、`from`、
  `to`（均引用已有会话，不得自指）、非空 `technique`、`cost`（1–100 的非布尔整数）；`starts` 是无重复会话
  id 的数组（id 必须存在）；goal 每项仅含 `id`、`target`、`min_privilege`（取值同 privilege）。先完成全部
  结构校验（结构错误、重复 id、未知引用、自指、非法 cost/privilege 均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有
  allow/deny 语义检查全部 session 与 goal 的规范化 target，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回
  局部路径。图可含环、跨目标边及同一对会话间的多条 transition。goal 仅由 target 规范化后相同且 privilege
  不低于 `min_privilege` 的会话满足。成功响应仅含与 `goals` 同序的 `paths`，每项含 `goal_id`、规范化
  `target`、`min_privilege`、`status`、`path`：不可达为 `status: "unreachable"`、`path: null`；可达为
  `status: "reachable"`，path 仅含 `start_session_id`、`end_session_id`、`total_cost`、`session_ids`、
  `transition_ids`，序列按行进顺序排列。起始会话直接满足目标时 total_cost 为 0、transition_ids 为空。最佳路径
  依次按总 cost、transition 数、start 输入位置、沿途 transition 输入位置序列、终点 session 输入位置由小到大
  决胜；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
- `POST /v1/requests/rate-limit-analyze`：离线分析请求观测中的限速超限与更换身份分摊流量的规避行为，不联网、
  不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`attempts`；`policy` 仅含 `window_ms` 与
  `max_requests`（均为正的非布尔整数）和 `group_by`（仅 `target` 或 `target_route`）；`attempts` 可为空
  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、以 `/` 开头的非空 `route`、
  非空 `identity` 和非负非布尔整数 `timestamp_ms`，不接受多余字段。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、
  重复 `id`、非法值均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个尝试的规范化
  `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。窗口起点为
  `floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms`；`group_by` 为 `target` 时按规范化目标与窗口分组，为
  `target_route` 时再按大小写敏感的 `route` 细分。组内总数大于 `max_requests` 才产生告警：组内至少两个
  `identity` 且每个身份的计数都不超过 `max_requests` 时 `kind` 为 `distributed_bypass`，否则为
  `direct_excess`。成功响应仅含 `alerts`，按窗口起点、目标首次出现位置、route 首次出现位置排序；每项仅含
  规范化 `target`、`route`（`target` 分组时为 `null`）、`window_start_ms`、`window_end_ms`（起点加
  `window_ms`）、`total_requests`、`identity_counts`（按身份首次出现顺序给出 `identity` 与 `count`）、
  `kind`、`attempt_ids`（按 `timestamp_ms` 升序，并列按输入顺序）。空 `attempts` 或无超限时返回空
  `alerts`；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
- `POST /v1/requests/schedule`：在请求发出前离线计算待执行请求的最早可用时间，不发送请求、不执行载荷、
  不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`requests`；`policy` 沿用限速分析的规则
  （`window_ms`、`max_requests` 为正的非布尔整数，`group_by` 仅 `target` 或 `target_route`）；
  `requests` 可为空数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、以 `/`
  开头的非空 `route`、非负非布尔整数 `earliest_ms` 和无重复请求 id 数组 `depends_on`，不接受多余字段。
  先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、依赖未知或重复、自依赖、依赖成环及
  非法范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个 `target` 的规范化形式，
  任一未获授权则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回部分计划；空 `requests` 仍校验 policy 与范围规则并
  返回空计划。编排采用稳定拓扑顺序（同层按输入位置靠前优先）；每个请求的候选时间取其 `earliest_ms` 与
  全部依赖项 `scheduled_ms` 的最大值，再寻找所属分组中尚未达到 `max_requests` 的最早固定窗口——窗口起点按
  `floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms` 计算，窗口已满则移至下一窗口起点。`group_by` 为 `target`
  时规范化目标共享限额，为 `target_route` 时按区分大小写的 `route` 分组。成功响应仅含 `schedule`，按
  `scheduled_ms` 升序排列，并列保持输入顺序；每项仅含 `id`、规范化 `target`、`route`、`scheduled_ms`、
  `window_start_ms` 及保持输入顺序的 `depends_on`。候选时间所在窗口有余位时执行时间为候选时间本身，
  被顺延则执行时间为下一窗口起点；相同输入始终产生相同结果。

"""HTTP entry point for RedForge."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from .service import ScopeViolationError, Service

SCOPE_PATH = "/v1/scope/evaluate"
MATCH_PATH = "/v1/vulnerabilities/match"
FINGERPRINT_PATH = "/v1/assets/fingerprint"
CONSOLIDATE_PATH = "/v1/findings/consolidate"
RETEST_PATH = "/v1/findings/retest"
PLAN_PATH = "/v1/attack-chains/plan"
EXPORT_PATH = "/v1/reports/export"
CREDENTIALS_PATH = "/v1/credentials/analyze"
PAYLOADS_PATH = "/v1/payloads/generate"
ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH = "/v1/sessions/escalation-paths"
RATE_LIMIT_PATH = "/v1/requests/rate-limit-analyze"
SCHEDULE_PATH = "/v1/requests/schedule"
POST_PATHS = (
    SCOPE_PATH,
    MATCH_PATH,
    FINGERPRINT_PATH,
    CONSOLIDATE_PATH,
    RETEST_PATH,
    PLAN_PATH,
    EXPORT_PATH,
    CREDENTIALS_PATH,
    PAYLOADS_PATH,
    ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH,
    RATE_LIMIT_PATH,
    SCHEDULE_PATH,
)
MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


def env_address() -> tuple[str, int]:
    raw = os.environ.get("REDFORGE_ADDR", "127.0.0.1:8080")
    host, _, port = raw.rpartition(":")
    if not host or not port.isdigit():
        raise SystemExit(f"invalid REDFORGE_ADDR: {raw!r}")
    return host, int(port)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    service = Service()

    def send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def send_error_json(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.send_json(status, {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}})

    def not_found(self) -> None:
        self.send_error_json(404, "not_found", f"no route for {self.path}")

    def reject_non_post(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        self.send_error(501, "Unsupported method (%r)" % self.command)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        if self.path == "/healthz":
            self.send_json(200, self.service.health())
            return
        self.not_found()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        if self.path == SCOPE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.evaluate_scope)
            return
        if self.path == MATCH_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.match_vulnerabilities)
            return
        if self.path == FINGERPRINT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.fingerprint_assets)
            return
        if self.path == CONSOLIDATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.consolidate_findings)
            return
        if self.path == RETEST_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.retest_findings)
            return
        if self.path == PLAN_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.plan_attack_chains)
            return
        if self.path == EXPORT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.export_report)
            return
        if self.path == CREDENTIALS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_credentials)
            return
        if self.path == PAYLOADS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.generate_payloads)
            return
        if self.path == ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.compute_escalation_paths)
            return
        if self.path == RATE_LIMIT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_rate_limit)
            return
        if self.path == SCHEDULE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.schedule_requests)
            return
        self.not_found()

    def _handle_json_post(self, handler) -> None:
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is None or not raw_length.isdigit():
            self.send_error_json(
                400, "invalid_request", "missing or invalid Content-Length"
            )
            return
        length = int(raw_length)
        if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
            # Do not drain an oversized body; drop the connection instead.
            self.close_connection = True
            self.send_error_json(413, "request_too_large", "body exceeds 1 MiB")
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            payload = json.loads(body)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", f"malformed JSON: {exc}")
            return
        try:
            result = handler(payload)
        except ScopeViolationError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(403, "scope_violation", str(exc))
            return
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", str(exc))
            return
        self.send_json(200, result)

    do_PUT = reject_non_post
    do_DELETE = reject_non_post
    do_PATCH = reject_non_post
    do_HEAD = reject_non_post

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:
        """Silence per-request logging so recorded output stays stable."""


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="redforge.server", description="渗透测试与攻防演练平台")
    host, port = env_address()
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=host)
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=port)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    print(f"RedForge listening on http://{args.host}:{httpd.server_address[1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

121	def _normalize_hostname(name: str) -> str:
122	    """Lowercase IDNA ASCII form without a trailing dot; raise on bad syntax."""
123	    if name.endswith("."):
124	        name = name[:-1]
125	    if not name:
126	        raise ValueError("empty hostname")
127	    try:
128	        ascii_name = name.encode("idna").decode("ascii").lower()
129	    except UnicodeError as exc:
130	        raise ValueError(f"invalid hostname: {name!r}") from exc
131	    if len(ascii_name) > 253:
132	        raise ValueError(f"hostname too long: {name!r}")
133	    for label in ascii_name.split("."):
134	        if not _LABEL_RE.fullmatch(label):
135	            raise ValueError(f"invalid hostname: {name!r}")
136	    return ascii_name

139	@dataclass(frozen=True)
140	class _Entry:
141	    """A normalized rule or target.
142	
143	    kind is one of "ip", "network", "host", "wildcard". text is the
144	    normalized representation; value is the parsed ip object for ip/network
145	    entries, or the normalized hostname (wildcard: the root hostname).
146	    """
147	
148	    kind: str
149	    text: str
150	    value: Any
151	
152	
153	def _parse_entry(raw: object, *, allow_wildcard: bool) -> _Entry:
154	    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw:
155	        raise ValueError(f"entries must be non-empty strings, got {raw!r}")
156	    if "/" in raw:
157	        try:
158	            network = ipaddress.ip_network(raw, strict=False)
159	        except ValueError as exc:
160	            raise ValueError(f"invalid CIDR: {raw!r}") from exc
161	        return _Entry("network", str(network), network)
162	    if raw.startswith("*."):
163	        if not allow_wildcard:
164	            raise ValueError(f"wildcard not allowed as target: {raw!r}")
165	        root = _normalize_hostname(raw[2:])
166	        return _Entry("wildcard", "*." + root, root)
167	    try:
168	        address = ipaddress.ip_address(raw)
169	    except ValueError:
170	        pass
171	    else:
172	        return _Entry("ip", str(address), address)
173	    hostname = _normalize_hostname(raw)
174	    return _Entry("host", hostname, hostname)

177	def _matches(rule: _Entry, target: _Entry) -> bool:
178	    """Whether a non-network target is covered by a rule."""
179	    if target.kind == "ip":
180	        if rule.kind == "ip":
181	            return rule.value == target.value
182	        if rule.kind == "network":
183	            return (
184	                rule.value.version == target.value.version
185	                and target.value in rule.value
186	            )
187	        return False
188	    if target.kind == "host":
189	        if rule.kind == "host":
190	            return rule.value == target.value
191	        if rule.kind == "wildcard":
192	            # Real subdomains only; the root domain itself does not match.
193	            return target.value != rule.value and target.value.endswith(
194	                "." + rule.value
195	            )
196	        return False
197	    return False

281	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
282	        raise ValueError(f"{what} must be an object")
283	    keys = set(raw)

285	        values = raw["values"]

287	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.values must be a non-empty array")
288	        if any(not _is_int(item) for item in values):
289	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.values must contain only integers")
290	        return _Matcher("status", None, None, frozenset(values))
291	    if keys == {"name", "operator", "value"}:
292	        kind = "header"
293	        name = raw["name"]
294	        if not isinstance(name, str):
295	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.name must be a string")
296	    elif keys == {"operator", "value"}:
297	        kind = "body"
298	        name = None
299	    else:
300	        raise ValueError(f"{what} has unknown or missing fields")
301	    operator = raw["operator"]

304	    value = raw["value"]

306	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.value must be a non-empty string")
307	    regex = None
308	    if operator == "regex":
309	        try:
310	            regex = re.compile(value)
311	        except re.error as exc:
312	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.value is an invalid regex: {exc}") from exc
313	    return _Matcher(kind, name, operator, value, regex)

915	def _render_payload_template(template: str, variables: dict[str, str], what: str) -> str:
916	    """Substitute ${name} placeholders exactly once.
917	
918	    Variable values are inserted verbatim and never re-scanned, so a value
919	    containing placeholders is not expanded. A missing reference, an unused
920	    variable, or a malformed placeholder makes the request invalid.
921	    """
922	    parts: list[str] = []
923	    referenced: set[str] = set()
924	    index = 0
925	    length = len(template)
926	    while index < length:
927	        if template[index] == "$" and index + 1 < length and template[index + 1] == "{":
928	            end = template.find("}", index + 2)
929	            if end == -1:
930	                raise ValueError(f"{what}.template has a malformed placeholder")
931	            name = template[index + 2 : end]
932	            if not _VARIABLE_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) or name not in variables:
933	                raise ValueError(
934	                    f"{what}.template has a malformed or unresolved placeholder"
935	                )
936	            parts.append(variables[name])
937	            referenced.add(name)
938	            index = end + 1
939	        else:
940	            parts.append(template[index])
941	            index += 1
942	    unused = set(variables) - referenced
943	    if unused:
944	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.variables has unused variable: {sorted(unused)[0]!r}")
945	    return "".join(parts)

980	    variants = [

1189	class Service:
1190	    """Health, authorization-scope evaluation, and offline template matching."""
1191	
1192	    name = "redforge"
1193	    version = __version__
1194	
1195	    def health(self) -> dict[str, str]:
1196	        return {"status": "ok", "service": self.name, "version": self.version}

1198	    def evaluate_scope(self, payload: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
1199	        """Evaluate targets against allow/deny scope rules.
1200	
1201	        Pure, local evaluation: no network access, no persistent state.
1202	        Raises ValueError on any malformed input; never returns partial
1203	        results.
1204	        """
1205	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
1206	            raise ValueError("payload must be an object")
1207	        fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
1208	        for key in ("allow", "deny", "targets"):
1209	            if key not in payload:
1210	                raise ValueError(f"missing field: {key}")
1211	            fields[key] = payload[key]
1212	        for key, value in fields.items():
1213	            if not isinstance(value, list):
1214	                raise ValueError(f"field {key} must be an array")
1215	            if len(value) > MAX_RULES_PER_FIELD:
1216	                raise ValueError(
1217	                    f"field {key} exceeds {MAX_RULES_PER_FIELD} entries"
1218	                )
1219	        if not fields["targets"]:
1220	            raise ValueError("targets must not be empty")
1221	
1222	        allow_rules = [
1223	            _parse_entry(raw, allow_wildcard=True) for raw in fields["allow"]
1224	        ]
1225	        deny_rules = [
1226	            _parse_entry(raw, allow_wildcard=True) for raw in fields["deny"]
1227	        ]
1228	        decisions = [
1229	            self._decide(raw, allow_rules, deny_rules)
1230	            for raw in fields["targets"]
1231	        ]
1232	        return {"decisions": decisions}
1233	
1234	    def _decide(
1235	        self,
1236	        raw_target: object,
1237	        allow_rules: list[_Entry],
1238	        deny_rules: list[_Entry],
1239	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1240	        target = _parse_entry(raw_target, allow_wildcard=False)
1241	        allowed, reason, matched_rule = self._evaluate(
1242	            target, allow_rules, deny_rules
1243	        )
1244	        return _decision(raw_target, target.text, allowed, reason, matched_rule)
1245	
1246	    def _evaluate(
1247	        self,
1248	        target: _Entry,
1249	        allow_rules: list[_Entry],
1250	        deny_rules: list[_Entry],
1251	    ) -> tuple[bool, str, str | None]:
1252	        """Decide a parsed target; return (allowed, reason, matched_rule)."""
1253	        if target.kind == "network":
1254	            # A CIDR target needs full containment in an allow network and
1255	            # must not intersect any deny network.
1256	            for rule in deny_rules:
1257	                if (
1258	                    rule.kind == "network"
1259	                    and rule.value.version == target.value.version
1260	                    and target.value.overlaps(rule.value)
1261	                ):
1262	                    return False, "deny_overlap", rule.text
1263	            for rule in allow_rules:
1264	                if (
1265	                    rule.kind == "network"
1266	                    and rule.value.version == target.value.version
1267	                    and target.value.subnet_of(rule.value)
1268	                ):
1269	                    return True, "allowed", rule.text
1270	            return False, "no_allow_match", None
1271	        # Deny wins over allow for point targets.
1272	        for rule in deny_rules:
1273	            if _matches(rule, target):
1274	                return False, "deny_match", rule.text
1275	        for rule in allow_rules:

1587	    @staticmethod
1588	    def _consolidate(
1589	        runs: list[tuple[str, int, list[_Finding]]],
1590	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
1591	        """De-duplicate validated findings by normalized target/template_id.
1592	
1593	        Callers are responsible for authorizing every finding target first.
1594	        """
1595	        groups: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
1596	        order: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
1597	        for _, _, findings in runs:
1598	            for finding in findings:
1599	                key = (finding.target.text, finding.template_id)
1600	                group = groups.get(key)
1601	                if group is None:
1602	                    group = {
1603	                        "name": finding.name,
1604	                        "severity": finding.severity,
1605	                        "observation_ids": [],
1606	                        "_observation_seen": set(),
1607	                        "sources": [],
1608	                        "_source_seen": set(),
1609	                        "evidence": set(),
1610	                        "confidence": 0,
1611	                    }
1612	                    groups[key] = group
1613	                    order.append(key)
1614	                elif group["name"] != finding.name:
1615	                    raise ValueError(
1616	                        "conflicting names for "
1617	                        f"({finding.target.text}, {finding.template_id}): "
1618	                        f"{group['name']!r} vs {finding.name!r}"
1619	                    )
1620	                if _SEVERITY_RANK[finding.severity] > _SEVERITY_RANK[
1621	                    group["severity"]
1622	                ]:
1623	                    group["severity"] = finding.severity
1624	                if finding.observation_id not in group["_observation_seen"]:
1625	                    group["_observation_seen"].add(finding.observation_id)
1626	                    group["observation_ids"].append(finding.observation_id)
1627	                group["evidence"].update(finding.evidence)
1628	
1629	        # Sources and confidence are attributed per distinct run, while
1630	        # observation ids and evidence still count repeated in-run findings.
1631	        for run_id, reliability, findings in runs:
1632	            touched = {
1633	                (finding.target.text, finding.template_id) for finding in findings
1634	            }
1635	            for key in touched:
1636	                group = groups[key]
1637	                if run_id not in group["_source_seen"]:
1638	                    group["_source_seen"].add(run_id)
1639	                    group["sources"].append(run_id)
1640	                c = group["confidence"]
1641	                group["confidence"] = c + (100 - c) * reliability // 100
1642	
1643	        consolidated = []
1644	        for key in order:
1645	            group = groups[key]
1646	            consolidated.append(
1647	                {
1648	                    "target": key[0],
1649	                    "template_id": key[1],
1650	                    "name": group["name"],
1651	                    "severity": group["severity"],
1652	                    "observation_ids": group["observation_ids"],
1653	                    "sources": group["sources"],
1654	                    "evidence": sorted(group["evidence"]),
1655	                    "confidence": group["confidence"],
1656	                }
1657	            )
1658	        return consolidated

1660	    def retest_findings(self, payload: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
1661	        """Compare one retest against a previous consolidation.
1662	
1663	        Pure, local evaluation: no network access, no persistent state. The
1664	        baseline carries the same shape as a consolidate response's
1665	        ``consolidated`` array; retest_runs has the runs shape. All structure
1666	        is validated and every target on both sides passes the scope gate
1667	        before anything is compared. Raises ValueError on malformed input and
1668	        ScopeViolationError for any out-of-scope target.
1669	        """
1670	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
1671	            raise ValueError("payload must be an object")
1672	        required = {"allow", "deny", "baseline", "retest_runs"}
1673	        keys = set(payload)
1674	        missing = required - keys
1675	        if missing:
1676	            raise ValueError(f"missing field: {sorted(missing)[0]}")
1677	        extra = keys - required
1678	        if extra:
1679	            raise ValueError(f"unknown field: {sorted(extra)[0]}")
1680	
1681	        allow_rules, deny_rules = self._parse_scope_rules(payload)
1682	
1683	        raw_baseline = payload["baseline"]
1684	        if not isinstance(raw_baseline, list):
1685	            raise ValueError("field baseline must be an array")
1686	        baseline_items = [
1687	            _parse_consolidated_item(raw, f"baseline[{i}]")
1688	            for i, raw in enumerate(raw_baseline)
1689	        ]
1690	
1691	        runs = self._parse_runs(payload["retest_runs"])
1692	
1693	        # Structural validation must finish before the scope gate, so a
1694	        # duplicate baseline key is a 400 even when a target is out of scope.
1695	        before: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
1696	        for item in baseline_items:
1697	            key = (item.target.text, item.template_id)
1698	            if key in before:
1699	                raise ValueError(
1700	                    f"duplicate baseline key: ({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r})"
1701	                )
1702	            before[key] = {
1703	                "target": item.target.text,
1704	                "template_id": item.template_id,
1705	                "name": item.name,
1706	                "severity": item.severity,
1707	                "observation_ids": list(item.observation_ids),
1708	                "sources": list(item.sources),
1709	                "evidence": sorted(item.evidence),
1710	                "confidence": item.confidence,
1711	            }
1712	
1713	        # Then gate every target from both sides; a single rejection voids
1714	        # the comparison.
1715	        self._assert_targets_in_scope(
1716	            (item.target for item in baseline_items),
1717	            allow_rules,
1718	            deny_rules,
1719	        )
1720	        self._assert_targets_in_scope(
1721	            (finding.target for _, _, findings in runs for finding in findings),
1722	            allow_rules,
1723	            deny_rules,
1724	        )
1725	
1726	        after_list = self._consolidate(runs)
1727	        after = {
1728	            (item["target"], item["template_id"]): item for item in after_list
1729	        }
1730	
1731	        comparisons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1732	        persistent = resolved = new = 0
1733	        # Baseline order first: same key is persistent, a missing key resolved.
1734	        for item in baseline_items:
1735	            key = (item.target.text, item.template_id)
1736	            current = after.get(key)
1737	            if current is None:

1739	                resolved += 1
1740	            else:

1742	                persistent += 1
1743	            comparisons.append(

1762	                    "template_id": key[1],
1763	                    "name": item["name"],
1764	                    "status": "new",
1765	                    "before": None,
1766	                    "after": item,
1767	                }
1768	            )

1770	        return {

1774	                "total_after": len(after),
1775	                "persistent": persistent,
1776	                "resolved": resolved,
1777	                "new": new,

2664	    @staticmethod
2665	    def _resolve_request_order(
2666	        requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
2667	    ) -> list[_ScheduledRequest]:
2668	        """Topologically order requests; same level keeps input order.
2669	
2670	        Raises ValueError on self-references, unknown ids, or cycles.
2671	        """
2672	        known = {request.id for request in requests}
2673	        for request in requests:
2674	            for dep in request.depends_on:
2675	                if dep == request.id:
2676	                    raise ValueError(
2677	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on itself"
2678	                    )
2679	                if dep not in known:
2680	                    raise ValueError(
2681	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on unknown id: "
2682	                        f"{dep!r}"
2683	                    )
2684	        remaining = list(requests)
2685	        done: set[str] = set()
2686	        ordered: list[_ScheduledRequest] = []
2687	        while remaining:
2688	            ready_now = [
2689	                request
2690	                for request in remaining
2691	                if all(dep in done for dep in request.depends_on)
2692	            ]
2693	            if not ready_now:
2694	                raise ValueError("request dependencies form a cycle")
2695	            for request in ready_now:
2696	                done.add(request.id)
2697	            ordered.extend(ready_now)
2698	            remaining = [
2699	                request for request in remaining if request.id not in done
2700	            ]
2701	        return ordered

2703	    @staticmethod
2704	    def _build_schedule(
2705	        ordered_requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
2706	        policy: _RateLimitPolicy,
2707	        input_positions: dict[str, int],
2708	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
2709	        """Place each request into the earliest non-saturated fixed window.
2710	
2711	        Candidates are walked in stable topological order, so input position
2712	        decides every occupancy tie. Per group, each fixed window holds at
2713	        most max_requests placements; a full window pushes the request to
2714	        the next window start.
2715	        """
2716	        window_ms = policy.window_ms
2717	        max_requests = policy.max_requests
2718	        scheduled_at: dict[str, int] = {}
2719	        # group -> {window_start: [request id, ...]} in placement order.
2720	        occupancy: dict[Any, dict[int, list[str]]] = {}
2721	        results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
2722	
2723	        for request in ordered_requests:
2724	            candidate = request.earliest_ms
2725	            for dep in request.depends_on:
2726	                if scheduled_at[dep] > candidate:
2727	                    candidate = scheduled_at[dep]
2728	            group: Any
2729	            if policy.group_by == "target_route":
2730	                group = (request.target.text, request.route)
2731	            else:
2732	                group = request.target.text
2733	            group_windows = occupancy.setdefault(group, {})
2734	            window_start = (candidate // window_ms) * window_ms
2735	            candidate_window = window_start
2736	            while len(group_windows.get(window_start, ())) >= max_requests:
2737	                window_start += window_ms
2738	            group_windows.setdefault(window_start, []).append(request.id)
2739	            # Room in the candidate's own window: execute at the candidate
2740	            # time; a bumped request executes at the next window start.
2741	            scheduled_ms = (
2742	                candidate if window_start == candidate_window else window_start
2743	            )
2744	            scheduled_at[request.id] = scheduled_ms
2745	            results.append(
2746	                {
2747	                    "id": request.id,
2748	                    "target": request.target.text,
2749	                    "route": request.route,
2750	                    "scheduled_ms": scheduled_ms,
2751	                    "window_start_ms": window_start,
2752	                    "depends_on": list(request.depends_on),
2753	                    "_pos": input_positions[request.id],
2754	                }
2755	            )

@staticmethod
def _evaluate_safety(actions, policy):
    decisions = []
    occupancy = {}  # (target_text, window_start) -> count
    allowed_count = 0
    for action in actions:
        status = "allowed"
        reason = None
        if not policy.enabled:
            status, reason = "blocked", "emergency_stop"
        elif action.kind in policy.blocked_kinds:
            status, reason = "blocked", "blocked_kind"
        else:
            window_start = (action.scheduled_ms // policy.window_ms) * policy.window_ms
            key = (action.target.text, window_start)
            count = occupancy.get(key, 0)
            if count >= policy.max_actions_per_target:
                status, reason = "blocked", "action_limit"
            else:
                occupancy[key] = count + 1
        if status == "allowed":
            allowed_count += 1
        decisions.append({...})
    summary = {"total": len(actions), "allowed": allowed_count, "blocked": len(actions) - allowed_count}
    return {"decisions": decisions, "summary": summary}
